questions.q: Which letter comes just after 'd'?
questions.exp: The order is a, b, c, d, e, so 'e' comes just after 'd'.

questions.q:
(Picture: the sun shining in the sky)
Which word names the picture?
questions.exp: The picture shows the sun, so the word is 'sun'.

questions.q: What colour is a ripe banana?
questions.exp: A ripe banana is yellow.

questions.q: Which word is a number?
questions.exp: 'Two' is the number 2; the others are things.

questions.q: Which word ends with the 't' sound?
questions.exp: h-a-t ends with the letter 't'.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: I ___ happy.
questions.exp: With 'I' we use 'am': I am happy.

questions.q: What is the opposite of 'open'?
questions.exp: When a door is not open, it is closed, so 'close' is the opposite.

questions.q: We see with our ___.
questions.exp: Eyes help us see; ears help us hear.

questions.q:
(Picture: a hen)
Put the letters e, h, n in the right order to name the picture.
questions.exp: h-e-n makes 'hen', the name of the bird in the picture.

questions.q:
Read: 'Ravi has a red ball. Tina has a blue kite.'
Who has a kite?
questions.exp: The second sentence says Tina has a blue kite.

questions.q:
(Picture: 4 balloons)
How many balloons are there?
questions.exp: Count them: 1, 2, 3, 4. There are 4 balloons.

questions.q: Which number comes just before 10?
questions.exp: Counting up: 8, 9, 10. So 9 comes just before 10.

questions.q: Which shape has 3 sides?
questions.exp: A triangle has 3 sides; a square and a rectangle have 4; a circle has none.

questions.q:
Which is the smallest number?
7, 3, 5, 8
questions.exp: 3 is less than 5, 7 and 8.
Start at 6 and count 3 more: 7, 8, 9. So 6 + 3 = 9.

questions.q:
(Picture: 7 birds on a wire. 2 birds fly away.)
How many birds are left?
questions.exp: 7 - 2 = 5 birds are left.

questions.q: Which is the heaviest?
questions.exp: An elephant is much heavier than a cat, a pencil or a leaf.

questions.q: Which number comes between 14 and 16?
questions.exp: 14, 15, 16. So 15 is between 14 and 16.

questions.q: Aman has 9 toffees. He eats 3 and gives 2 to his sister. How many toffees are left?
questions.exp: 9 - 3 = 6, then 6 - 2 = 4 toffees are left.

questions.q:
What comes next?
2, 4, 6, 8, ___
questions.exp: Each number is 2 more than the one before: 8 + 2 = 10.

questions.q: 'अ' के बाद कौन-सा स्वर आता है?
questions.exp: स्वरों का क्रम अ, आ, इ, ई है, इसलिए 'अ' के बाद 'आ' आता है।

questions.q:
(चित्र: एक लाल सेब)
चित्र का नाम क्या है?
questions.exp: चित्र में लाल सेब है।

questions.q: दूध का रंग कैसा होता है?
questions.exp: दूध सफ़ेद रंग का होता है।

questions.q: 'पतंग' शब्द किस अक्षर से शुरू होता है?
questions.exp: 'पतंग' में पहला अक्षर 'प' है।

questions.q: किस शब्द में 'ि' (इ) की मात्रा है?
questions.exp: 'दिन' में 'द' पर 'ि' की मात्रा लगी है।

questions.q: अक्षर जोड़िए: घ + र = ?
questions.exp: 'घ' और 'र' जोड़ने से 'घर' बनता है।

questions.q: एक हाथ में कितनी उँगलियाँ होती हैं?
questions.exp: एक हाथ में पाँच उँगलियाँ होती हैं।

questions.q: 'दाल' से तुक मिलाने वाला शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'दाल' और 'बाल' दोनों के अंत में 'आल' की ध्वनि है।

questions.q: इनमें से दो अक्षर वाला शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'जल' में दो अक्षर (ज, ल) हैं; बाकी शब्दों में तीन अक्षर हैं।

questions.q:
पढ़िए: 'राम के पास एक गाय है। गाय दूध देती है।'
गाय क्या देती है?
questions.exp: वाक्य में लिखा है कि गाय दूध देती है।

questions.q: Which day comes after Monday?
questions.exp: The order is Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, so Tuesday comes after Monday.

questions.q: Which word tells how something looks?
questions.exp: 'Tall' describes a thing; run, eat and sing are action words.

questions.q: Which spelling is correct?
questions.exp: The correct spelling is s-c-h-o-o-l.

questions.q: What is the opposite of 'fast'?
questions.exp: Fast and slow are opposites; 'quick' means the same as fast.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: The birds ___ singing.
questions.exp: 'Birds' means more than one, so we use 'are'.

questions.q: Sita is my friend. ___ is very kind.
questions.exp: Sita is a girl, so we use 'She'.

questions.q: Which sentence needs a question mark (?) at the end?
questions.exp: 'Where is my bag' asks something, so it ends with a question mark.

questions.q:
(Picture: a cat sitting below a table)
The cat is ___ the table.
questions.exp: The cat is below the table, so it is under the table.

questions.q: Yesterday I ___ to the park.
questions.exp: 'Yesterday' means the past, so we use 'went'.

questions.q:
Read: 'Asha got up at 6. She drank milk. Then she went to school by bus.'
What did Asha do after she drank milk?
questions.exp: The passage says that after drinking milk, 'then she went to school'.

questions.q: How many tens are there in 63?
questions.exp: 63 = 6 tens and 3 ones.

questions.q: Which is the number name of 25?
questions.exp: 25 is 2 tens and 5 ones: twenty-five.

questions.q: How many corners does a square have?
questions.exp: A square has 4 sides and 4 corners.
Add 10 each time: 30 + 10 = 40.

questions.q:
(Picture: 3 plates with 4 laddoos on each plate)
How many laddoos are there in all?
How many days are there in one week?
questions.exp: A week has 7 days, from Sunday to Saturday.

questions.q: A bus had 45 people. At a stop, 12 people got off and 8 people got on. How many people are in the bus now?
Meena has two ₹10 notes and three ₹5 coins. How much money does she have?
'ऊपर' का उलटा शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'ऊपर' का उलटा 'नीचे' होता है।

questions.q: इनमें से जानवर कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: शेर एक जानवर है; गुलाब फूल है, मेज़ चीज़ है और बादल आसमान में होते हैं।

questions.q: इनमें से सब्ज़ी कौन-सी है?
questions.exp: आलू सब्ज़ी है; केला, अंगूर और संतरा फल हैं।

questions.q: किस शब्द में 'ो' (ओ) की मात्रा है?
questions.exp: 'घोड़ा' में 'घ' पर 'ो' की मात्रा लगी है।

questions.q: 'कुर्सी' का अनेक (बहुवचन) रूप कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'ई' वाले शब्द अनेक में 'इयाँ' बन जाते हैं: कुर्सी - कुर्सियाँ।

questions.q: 'शेर' का स्त्रीलिंग शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: मादा शेर को 'शेरनी' कहते हैं।

questions.q: सही वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
questions.exp: सही शब्द 'पानी' है, जिसमें 'प' पर 'ा' और 'न' पर 'ी' की मात्रा है।

questions.q: खाली जगह भरिए: सूरज ___ को निकलता है।
questions.exp: सूरज सुबह को निकलता है, रात को नहीं।

questions.q:
पढ़िए: 'मीना बाज़ार गई। उसने दो केले और एक आम खरीदा।'
मीना ने कुल कितने फल खरीदे?
questions.exp: दो केले और एक आम मिलकर 2 + 1 = 3, यानी तीन फल हुए।

questions.q: सही क्रम वाला वाक्य कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: हिंदी वाक्य में पहले कर्ता (मैं), फिर स्थान (स्कूल) और अंत में क्रिया (जाता हूँ) आती है।

questions.q: Which word is a naming word (noun)?
questions.exp: 'Garden' is the name of a place; the others are not naming words.

questions.q: What is the opposite of 'early'?
questions.exp: Early and late are opposites.

questions.q: What is the plural of 'child'?
questions.exp: 'Child' becomes 'children' (not 'childs').

questions.q: Which word means the same as 'big'?
questions.exp: 'Large' and 'big' mean the same; 'small' is the opposite.

questions.q:
Find the describing word:
'The old man sat on a bench.'
questions.exp: 'Old' tells us what the man is like, so it is a describing word.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: Last Sunday we ___ a movie.
questions.exp: 'Last Sunday' is in the past, so we use 'watched'.

questions.q:
The book is inside the bag.
The book is ___ the bag.
questions.exp: Inside means 'in', so the book is in the bag.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: ___ is your name?
questions.exp: We ask about a name with 'What': What is your name?

questions.q:
Read: 'Tara wanted a kite. She saved one rupee every day for ten days. Then she bought a kite for ten rupees.'
Why did Tara save money?
questions.exp: Tara wanted a kite, and she used the ten rupees she saved to buy one.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
questions.exp: With 'she' we use 'is', and the verb takes '-ing': She is reading a book.

questions.q: Which number is 400 + 30 + 8?
questions.exp: 4 hundreds, 3 tens and 8 ones make 438.
The table of 8: 8 x 5 = 40.

questions.q: Which number comes just after 299?
How many sides does a rectangle have?
questions.exp: A rectangle has 4 sides (2 long and 2 short).

questions.q: One box has 9 pencils. How many pencils are there in 4 boxes?
questions.exp: 9 x 4 = 36 pencils.

questions.q: How many minutes are there in one hour?
questions.exp: 1 hour = 60 minutes.

questions.q: A roti is cut into 4 equal parts. What is one part called?
questions.exp: One of 4 equal parts is one-fourth (1/4).

questions.q: Ravi buys 3 notebooks for ₹25 each. He pays with a ₹100 note. How much money does he get back?

What comes next?
5, 10, 20, 40, ___
questions.exp: Each number is double the one before: 40 x 2 = 80.

questions.q: 'सूरज' का समान अर्थ वाला शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'सूरज' और 'सूर्य' का अर्थ एक ही है।

questions.q: 'सच' का विलोम शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'सच' का उलटा 'झूठ' होता है।

questions.q: 'राजा' का स्त्रीलिंग शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'राजा' का स्त्रीलिंग 'रानी' है।

questions.q: 'नदी' का बहुवचन कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: ई से अंत होने वाले शब्द बहुवचन में 'इयाँ' हो जाते हैं: नदी - नदियाँ।

questions.q:
'बच्चे मैदान में दौड़ते हैं।'
इस वाक्य में क्रिया शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'दौड़ते हैं' से काम करने का पता चलता है, इसलिए यह क्रिया है।

questions.q:
'राधा के पास काली बिल्ली है।'
इस वाक्य में विशेषण शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'काली' शब्द बिल्ली का रंग बताता है, इसलिए यह विशेषण है।

questions.q: खाली जगह भरिए: रमेश स्कूल गया। ___ कल भी स्कूल गया था।
questions.exp: रमेश के स्थान पर 'वह' सर्वनाम आएगा।

questions.q: प्रश्न पूछने वाले वाक्य के अंत में कौन-सा चिह्न लगता है?
questions.exp: प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य के अंत में प्रश्नवाचक चिह्न (?) लगता है।

questions.q:
पढ़िए: 'गीता ने अपने पौधे को रोज़ पानी दिया। कुछ दिन बाद उसमें सुंदर फूल खिले। गीता बहुत खुश हुई।'
गीता खुश क्यों हुई?
questions.exp: गद्यांश के अनुसार पौधे में सुंदर फूल खिलने पर गीता खुश हुई।

questions.q: वर्णमाला के क्रम में सबसे पहले कौन-सा शब्द आएगा?
questions.exp: वर्णमाला में क्रम क, ख, ग, घ है, इसलिए 'क' से शुरू होने वाला 'कमल' सबसे पहले आएगा।

questions.q: Which animal has a long trunk?
questions.exp: An elephant uses its long trunk to pick up food and drink water.

questions.q: Which part of a plant holds it firmly in the soil?
questions.exp: Roots grow into the soil and hold the plant in place.

questions.q: Which festival is called the festival of lights?
questions.exp: On Diwali people light diyas and lamps; Holi is the festival of colours.

questions.q: Your father's mother is your ___.
questions.exp: Your father's mother is your grandmother (dadi).

questions.q: Which of these foods comes from a plant?
questions.exp: Wheat is a grain from a plant; egg, milk and butter come from animals.

questions.q: Which of these is a natural source of water?
questions.exp: A river is made by nature; taps, buckets and bottles are made by people.

questions.q: Why should we wash our hands before eating?
questions.exp: Washing hands with soap removes germs that can make us ill.

questions.q: Which waste can be turned into compost (manure)?
questions.exp: Fruit peels rot in the soil and become compost; glass, plastic and tin do not.

questions.q: Ria lives on an island. She wants to cross the sea to reach the mainland. What is the best way for her to travel?
questions.exp: Buses, bicycles and trains cannot go on the sea, but a boat can.

questions.q: A crow builds a nest on a tree. A squirrel eats its fruits. Cows rest in its shade. What does this show?
questions.b: Trees need cows to grow tall
questions.d: Animals get home, food and shade from trees
questions.exp: The tree gives the crow a home, the squirrel food and the cows shade.

questions.q: Which colour do we get when we mix red and white?
questions.exp: Adding white to red makes a lighter red, which is pink.

questions.q: Which of these is used to paint a picture?
questions.exp: We dip a brush in colour to paint.

questions.q: Which musical instrument has strings?
questions.exp: A sitar is played by plucking its strings; the others are drums or wind instruments.

questions.q: In Indian dance, 'mudras' are shown mainly with our ___.
questions.exp: Mudras are special hand gestures used in dance.

questions.q: Where is rangoli usually made?
questions.exp: Rangoli is drawn with coloured powder on the floor, often at the doorway.

questions.q: Which of these makes a loud sound?
questions.exp: A drum beat is loud; the others are soft sounds.

questions.q: A puppet that is moved with strings from above is called a ___ puppet.
questions.exp: String puppets (kathputli) are moved by pulling strings.

questions.q: In a play, what do we call the people who act on stage?
questions.exp: Actors play the roles; the audience watches the play.

questions.q: Riya painted a tree green. She wants a lighter green for new leaves. What should she mix into the green?
questions.exp: Adding white makes a colour lighter; black makes it darker.

questions.q:
Look at this rhythm pattern:
clap, clap, pause, clap, clap, pause, ___
What comes next?
questions.exp: The pattern 'clap, clap, pause' repeats, so after a pause comes 'clap'.

questions.q: In which game does a raider say 'kabaddi, kabaddi' while touching players?
questions.exp: In kabaddi the raider keeps saying 'kabaddi' in one breath.

questions.q: In which game do we mostly kick the ball with our feet?
questions.exp: In football players kick the ball with their feet.

questions.q: How should we sit while reading or writing?
questions.exp: Sitting with a straight back keeps our spine healthy.

questions.q: Which food helps us grow strong?
questions.exp: Fruits and dal give our body vitamins and protein.

questions.q: In yoga, we usually breathe in and out through the ___.
questions.exp: In yoga we breathe slowly through the nose.

questions.q: What should we do when our exercise is over?
questions.c: Eat a big meal at once
questions.d: Sit on a hot bench in the sun
questions.exp: A cool-down with slow stretching helps the body relax slowly.

questions.q: Standing on one leg for some time mainly improves our ___.
questions.exp: Standing on one leg trains the body to stay steady, which is balance.

questions.q: In kho-kho, the chaser touches a sitting teammate on the back and says ___.
questions.exp: The chaser says 'kho' to pass the chase to a teammate.

questions.q: Anu feels thirsty and tired after running on a hot day. What should she do?
questions.b: Rest in the shade and drink water
questions.exp: Rest in shade cools the body, and water replaces the water lost in sweat.

questions.q: Rohan is doing Shavasana. What is he doing?
questions.c: Bending forward to touch his toes
questions.d: Lying on his back, fully relaxed
questions.exp: Shavasana (corpse pose) is done lying flat on the back, relaxing the whole body.

questions.q: Which word is spelt correctly?
questions.exp: The correct spelling is 'beautiful' (b-e-a-u-t-i-f-u-l).

questions.q: Which word means the same as 'glad'?
questions.exp: 'Glad' and 'happy' both mean feeling pleased.

questions.q: Choose the word to fill the blank: Rohan is my friend. ___ lives next door.
questions.exp: Rohan is one boy, so we use the pronoun 'He'.

questions.q: What is the plural of 'box'?
questions.exp: Words ending in 'x' take 'es' in the plural: box - boxes.

questions.q: Which sentence tells about something that happened in the past?
questions.b: Priya paints a picture every day.
questions.c: Priya will paint a picture tomorrow.
questions.d: Priya is painting a picture now.
questions.exp: 'Painted' and 'yesterday' show that the action happened in the past.

questions.q: Read: 'The little bird sang a sweet song.' Which word describes the song?
questions.exp: 'Sweet' tells us what kind of song it was; 'little' describes the bird, not the song.

questions.q: Which sentence uses capital letters correctly?
questions.exp: A sentence begins with a capital letter, and names of places like Delhi also start with a capital.

questions.q: Choose the best word: The ball rolled ___ the bed, so I could not see it.
questions.exp: The ball was hidden from view, so it must have rolled under the bed.

questions.q: Read: 'Asha woke up late. She missed the school bus, so her father drove her to school. She reached just as the bell rang.' Why did Asha's father drive her to school?
questions.exp: The passage says she missed the school bus, 'so' her father drove her.

questions.q: Arrange the words to make a correct sentence: the / in / swim / fish / pond / the
questions.a: Swim the fish in pond the.
questions.b: The pond swim in the fish.
questions.c: The fish swim in the pond.
questions.d: In fish the swim pond the.
questions.exp: A sentence needs the doer first (The fish), then the action (swim), then the place (in the pond).

questions.q: Which number is 'three thousand four hundred six'?
questions.exp: 3 thousands, 4 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones make 3,406.

questions.q: Which of these shapes has no corners?
questions.exp: A circle is a round closed curve, so it has no corners.

questions.q: 1 litre = ___ millilitres
questions.exp: 1 litre is equal to 1000 millilitres.

questions.q: Which is the smallest number?
questions.exp: 455 has only 4 hundreds; the others have 5 hundreds, so 455 is the smallest.

questions.q: Reema shares 84 marbles equally among 4 friends. How many marbles does each friend get?
A pizza is cut into 8 equal slices. 3 slices are eaten. What fraction of the pizza is left?
questions.exp: 8 - 3 = 5 slices are left out of 8, so 5/8 is left.

questions.q: How many minutes are there in 2 hours?
questions.exp: 1 hour = 60 minutes, so 2 hours = 2 × 60 = 120 minutes.

questions.q: Find the next number in the pattern: 3, 7, 11, 15, ___
questions.exp: Each number is 4 more than the one before, so 15 + 4 = 19.

questions.q: A bus has 48 seats. 175 children are going on a school trip and each child needs a seat. What is the least number of buses needed?
questions.exp: 3 buses give 3 × 48 = 144 seats (too few); 4 buses give 192 seats, enough for 175 children.

questions.q: Ravi buys 3 notebooks at ₹35 each and one pen for ₹20. How much does he pay in all?
'ऊँचा' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.exp: 'ऊँचा' का उल्टा अर्थ 'नीचा' होता है।

questions.q: 'सूरज' का पर्यायवाची शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'सूरज' और 'सूर्य' दोनों का अर्थ एक ही है।

questions.q: 'घोड़ा' का स्त्रीलिंग शब्द क्या है?
questions.exp: 'घोड़ा' पुल्लिंग है, इसका स्त्रीलिंग 'घोड़ी' है।

questions.q: शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
questions.exp: सही वर्तनी 'विद्यालय' है।

questions.q: 'बिल्ली' शब्द का बहुवचन क्या होगा?
questions.exp: ई से अंत होने वाले स्त्रीलिंग शब्दों का बहुवचन 'इयाँ' लगाकर बनता है: बिल्ली - बिल्लियाँ।

questions.q: 'सीता गाना गाती है।' इस वाक्य में क्रिया शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'गाती है' से काम का होना पता चलता है, इसलिए यह क्रिया है।

questions.q: हिंदी में वाक्य के अंत में लगने वाला पूर्ण विराम चिह्न कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: हिंदी में वाक्य पूरा होने पर खड़ी पाई (।) यानी पूर्ण विराम लगाया जाता है।

questions.q: 'नौ दो ग्यारह होना' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.exp: 'नौ दो ग्यारह होना' का अर्थ है जल्दी से भाग जाना।

questions.q: गद्यांश पढ़िए: 'अमन ने देखा कि चिड़िया का एक बच्चा घोंसले से नीचे गिर गया है। उसने उसे धीरे से उठाया और माली काका की मदद से वापस घोंसले में रख दिया।' इससे अमन के बारे में क्या पता चलता है?
questions.exp: अमन ने चिड़िया के बच्चे की मदद की, इससे पता चलता है कि वह दयालु है।

questions.q: किस वाक्य में शब्दों का क्रम सही है?
questions.a: मैं रोज़ सुबह दूध पीता हूँ।
questions.b: रोज़ मैं पीता दूध सुबह हूँ।
questions.c: दूध हूँ मैं पीता सुबह रोज़।
questions.d: पीता सुबह हूँ मैं दूध रोज़।
questions.exp: हिंदी वाक्य में पहले कर्ता (मैं), फिर समय, फिर कर्म (दूध) और अंत में क्रिया (पीता हूँ) आती है।

questions.q: Which of these animals lives in water?
questions.exp: A fish lives in water and breathes using gills.

questions.q: Which part of a plant takes in water from the soil?
questions.exp: Roots grow in the soil and absorb water and minerals for the plant.

questions.q: Which of these birds cannot fly?
questions.exp: The ostrich is a large, heavy bird that runs fast but cannot fly.

questions.q: Which of these foods do we get from plants?
questions.exp: Rice is a grain from the rice plant; egg, milk and curd come from animals.

questions.q: Which of these waste items can be turned into compost (manure)?
questions.exp: Vegetable peels rot naturally and become manure; plastic, glass and metal do not rot.

questions.q: Camels can live easily in deserts mainly because they...
questions.a: have thick fur to keep warm in the snow
questions.c: can go without water for many days
questions.d: eat only fish from the sea
questions.exp: Deserts have very little water, and camels can survive many days without drinking.

questions.q: Why should we wash our hands with soap before eating?
questions.exp: Soap and water wash away germs that could enter our body with food and make us ill.

questions.q: A potted plant kept in a dark cupboard for a week turns pale and weak. What is the most likely reason?
questions.exp: Green plants need sunlight to make their food; without it they become pale and weak.

questions.q: Rani's grandmother needs spectacles to read the newspaper, and her grandfather walks with a stick. What does this tell us?
questions.a: Old people never like reading the newspaper
questions.b: Our body's abilities can change as we grow old
questions.d: Walking sticks are only worn for fashion
questions.exp: As people grow older, eyesight and body strength often become weaker, so they need such help.

questions.q: A family lives in a hilly place where it rains very heavily. Which feature of their house would be most useful?
questions.exp: A sloping roof lets rainwater flow down quickly instead of collecting on the roof.

questions.q: Which of these is a string instrument?
questions.exp: The veena makes music when its strings are plucked.

questions.q: Mixing blue and red colours gives which colour?
questions.exp: Blue and red together make purple (violet).

questions.q: Which tool do we use to apply paint on paper?
questions.exp: A paintbrush is used to spread paint on paper.

questions.q: Which of these instruments is played by blowing air into it?
questions.exp: The shehnai is a wind instrument; tabla and mridangam are drums, sitar has strings.

questions.q: Kathak is a classical dance mainly from which state?
questions.exp: Kathak grew up in North India, mainly in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.q: What happens when we add white to a colour?
questions.exp: Adding white makes a lighter shade of the colour, e.g. red + white = pink.

questions.q: In Indian music, what is the word for the speed (tempo) of a song?
questions.exp: 'Laya' means the speed or tempo at which music is sung or played.

questions.q: Which art uses folded paper, without glue or scissors, to make shapes like a boat or a bird?
questions.exp: Origami is the art of folding paper into shapes.

questions.q: Riya wants her painting to show a calm, quiet night sky. Which colours suit it best?
questions.exp: Dark, cool colours like deep blue and black give the feeling of a calm night.

questions.q: In a class play, Meera must show that her character is very sad without speaking. What should she do?
questions.a: Droop her shoulders and look down
questions.exp: Body language like drooping shoulders and a lowered face shows sadness without words.

questions.q: Which game is played with a racket and a shuttlecock?
questions.exp: Badminton is played by hitting a shuttlecock with rackets over a net.

questions.q: Shavasana is done lying on the ___.
questions.exp: In Shavasana we lie flat on our back and relax the whole body.

questions.q: About how many hours of sleep does a child of your age need every night?
questions.exp: Children of 9-10 years need around 9 to 11 hours of sleep to grow and stay active.

questions.q: Which is the healthiest snack to eat after playing?
questions.exp: Fruits give energy, vitamins and water; the others are mostly sugar, salt or oil.

questions.q: In Tadasana (Mountain Pose), how do we stand?
questions.a: Balancing on one leg with arms up
questions.b: On our hands with legs in the air
questions.c: Straight and tall with feet together
questions.exp: In Tadasana we stand straight and tall, like a mountain, stretching upwards.

questions.q: Which asana is done sitting on the knees with the heels under the hips?
questions.exp: Vajrasana is the kneeling pose where we sit on our heels.

questions.q: Why should we breathe slowly and deeply while doing yoga?
questions.a: To finish all the asanas quickly
questions.c: To feel very hungry after yoga
questions.d: To stay calm and take in more air
questions.exp: Slow, deep breathing calms the mind and brings more oxygen into the body.

questions.q: In a relay race, what does a runner pass to the next runner of the team?
questions.exp: In a relay, each runner hands a baton to the next teammate.

questions.q: During a game of kho-kho in the hot sun, a player feels dizzy and very tired. What should be done first?
questions.a: Take the player to shade and give water
questions.b: Ask the player to keep running till the end
questions.c: Make the player sit in the sun
questions.d: Ask the player to do push-ups to feel better
questions.exp: Dizziness in heat means the body is overheated and short of water, so rest in shade and water come first.

questions.q: Arun runs fast but gets tired quickly. Which habit will best build his stamina?
questions.c: Jogging a little longer every day
questions.exp: Slowly increasing jogging time each day trains the heart and lungs, which builds stamina.

questions.q: Fill in the blank with the correct collective noun: a ___ of cows
questions.exp: A group of cows is called a herd.

questions.q: What is the simple past tense of 'write'?
questions.exp: 'Write' is an irregular verb; its simple past form is 'wrote'.

questions.q: Which word is the opposite of 'ancient'?
questions.exp: 'Ancient' means very old, so its opposite is 'modern'.

questions.q: Which word is the joining word (conjunction) in: 'I was hungry, so I ate an apple.'?
questions.exp: 'So' joins the two parts of the sentence and shows the result.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.
questions.exp: When comparing one thing with all others, we use the superlative form 'highest'.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the future tense?
questions.a: We will visit the museum next week.
questions.b: We visited the museum last week.
questions.d: We visit the museum every month.
questions.exp: 'Will visit' and 'next week' show an action that is going to happen.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: I can ___ the birds singing.
questions.exp: 'Hear' means to listen with the ears; 'here' means this place.

questions.q: What does the idiom 'a piece of cake' mean in: 'The test was a piece of cake'?
questions.exp: 'A piece of cake' means something very easy to do.

questions.q: Read: 'For weeks the farmers watched the sky. The fields were dry and cracked. When dark clouds finally gathered, the villagers ran out, laughing and dancing.' Why were the villagers dancing?
questions.a: Rain was coming after a long dry time
questions.c: The crops were ready to be cut
questions.exp: The dry, cracked fields and dark clouds show that rain was finally coming, which made them happy.

questions.q: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
questions.exp: It starts with a capital letter, has a comma after the interjection 'Wow', and ends with an exclamation mark.

questions.q: What is the place value of 5 in 3,52,418?
questions.exp: 5 is in the ten-thousands place, so its value is 5 × 10,000 = 50,000.

questions.q: Which of these angles is an acute angle?
questions.exp: An acute angle is less than 90°; only 45° is less than 90°.

questions.q: 1 kilometre = ___ metres
questions.exp: 1 km is equal to 1000 m.

questions.q: How many hours are there in 3 days?
questions.exp: 1 day = 24 hours, so 3 days = 3 × 24 = 72 hours.

questions.q: What is the largest 4-digit number that can be made using the digits 4, 0, 7 and 2 once each?
questions.exp: Place digits from largest to smallest: 7, 4, 2, 0 gives 7420.

questions.q: A rectangle has an area of 48 square cm and a length of 8 cm. What is its width?
questions.exp: Area = length × width, so width = 48 ÷ 8 = 6 cm.

questions.q: Which fraction is greater than 1/2?
questions.exp: Half of 7 is 3.5, and 4 is more than 3.5, so 4/7 > 1/2; the others have numerators less than half their denominators.

questions.q: A train leaves at 10:45 am. The journey takes 2 hours 30 minutes. At what time does it arrive?
A water tank holds 2,500 litres. A pipe fills 125 litres every minute. How long will it take to fill the empty tank?
questions.exp: 2,500 ÷ 125 = 20, so it takes 20 minutes.

questions.q: A packet of 12 pens costs ₹90. At the same rate, how much will 30 pens cost?
'अमृत' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.exp: 'अमृत' का उल्टा अर्थ 'विष' (ज़हर) है।

questions.q: 'पेड़' का पर्यायवाची शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'पेड़' और 'वृक्ष' का अर्थ एक ही है।

questions.q: 'नदी' शब्द का बहुवचन क्या है?
questions.exp: 'नदी' का बहुवचन 'नदियाँ' होता है।

questions.q: 'धोबी' का स्त्रीलिंग शब्द क्या है?
questions.exp: 'धोबी' पुल्लिंग है और इसका स्त्रीलिंग 'धोबिन' है।

questions.q: 'दाँत खट्टे करना' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.exp: 'दाँत खट्टे करना' का अर्थ है किसी को बुरी तरह हरा देना।

questions.q: 'कल मैं मेले में जाऊँगा।' यह वाक्य किस काल में है?
questions.exp: 'जाऊँगा' से पता चलता है कि काम आगे होगा, इसलिए यह भविष्यत् काल है।

questions.q: 'विद्यालय' शब्द किन दो शब्दों से मिलकर बना है?
questions.exp: विद्या + आलय = विद्यालय, अर्थात् विद्या का घर।

questions.topic: अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द
questions.q: 'जो सदा सच बोलता हो' - इसके लिए एक शब्द चुनिए।
questions.exp: सदा सत्य बोलने वाले को 'सत्यवादी' कहते हैं।

questions.q: गद्यांश पढ़िए: 'रोहन के परीक्षा में कम अंक आए। वह निराश नहीं हुआ। उसने रोज़ थोड़ा-थोड़ा पढ़ना शुरू किया और अगली परीक्षा में अच्छे अंक पाए।' इस गद्यांश से क्या सीख मिलती है?
questions.a: लगातार मेहनत से सफलता मिलती है
questions.c: पढ़ाई से केवल थकान होती है
questions.exp: रोहन ने हार नहीं मानी और रोज़ पढ़कर अच्छे अंक पाए, यानी लगातार मेहनत से सफलता मिलती है।

questions.q: किस वाक्य में विराम चिह्नों का सही प्रयोग हुआ है?
questions.d: राम, सीता और लक्ष्मण वन गए?
questions.exp: इसमें 'कहा' के बाद अल्प विराम, कथन के लिए उद्धरण चिह्न और अंत में पूर्ण विराम सही लगे हैं; बाकी वाक्यों में प्रश्नवाचक या पूर्ण विराम गलत जगह है।

questions.q: Which animal has a very strong sense of smell and is used by the police to find things?
questions.exp: Dogs have a very sharp sense of smell, so police use them to track people and find hidden things.

questions.q: Which gas do we need to breathe in to stay alive?
questions.exp: Our body uses oxygen from the air to get energy from food.

questions.q: Which part of our body pumps blood to all parts of the body?
questions.exp: The heart works like a pump and sends blood around the body.

questions.q: Which crop is usually grown in fields filled with standing water?
questions.exp: Rice (paddy) needs a lot of water and is grown in flooded fields.

questions.q: Why does an ice cream melt when it is kept outside on a hot day?
questions.a: Heat changes the solid into a liquid
questions.b: Air makes it sweeter and softer
questions.c: Light from the Sun turns it into a gas
questions.d: It soaks up extra water from the air
questions.exp: The warmth of the surroundings heats the solid ice cream and turns it into a liquid.

questions.q: Mountaineers carry oxygen cylinders when they climb very high peaks. Why?
questions.a: It is very hot up there
questions.b: There are no trees to hide
questions.c: The air has less oxygen high up
questions.d: They need it to cook food
questions.exp: At great heights the air is thin and has less oxygen, so breathing becomes difficult.

questions.q: Which of these helps stop soil from being washed away by rain?
questions.exp: Roots of trees and grass hold the soil together, so rain cannot wash it away easily.

questions.q: Moong seeds kept on dry cotton do not sprout, but seeds kept on wet cotton sprout in 2 days. What does this show?
questions.d: Seeds always need soil to sprout
questions.exp: The only difference between the two was water, so the seeds needed water to sprout.

questions.q: A large forest is cut down to build a highway. What is most likely to happen to the animals living there?
questions.a: They will get more food to eat
questions.b: They will grow bigger and stronger
questions.d: They lose their homes and food
questions.exp: The forest gives animals food and shelter; without it they lose their homes and food.

questions.q: In a field, grasshoppers eat grass, frogs eat grasshoppers, and snakes eat frogs. If all the frogs die, what is most likely to happen first?
questions.exp: Frogs eat grasshoppers; with no frogs left, fewer grasshoppers are eaten, so their number rises.

questions.q: Which of these is a percussion (drum) instrument?
questions.exp: The dholak is a drum played by striking it with the hands.

questions.q: Odissi is a classical dance from which state?
questions.exp: Odissi comes from the state of Odisha.

questions.q: Which colour do we get by mixing black and white?
questions.exp: Black mixed with white gives grey.

questions.q: Clay objects that are shaped and then baked in fire are called ___.
questions.exp: 'Terracotta' means baked earth - clay items hardened by firing.

questions.q: Which of these is a secondary colour?
questions.exp: Orange is made by mixing two primary colours (red and yellow), so it is secondary.

questions.q: Bhangra is a lively folk dance of which state?
questions.exp: Bhangra is a harvest folk dance of Punjab.

questions.q: In a drawing, how should a tree that is far away be drawn compared to a tree nearby?
questions.exp: Things far away look smaller to our eyes, so we draw them smaller to show distance.

questions.q: In Indian music, what is 'taal'?
questions.exp: Taal is the rhythmic cycle of beats that repeats in a piece of music.

questions.q: Kabir is making a 'Save Trees' poster that must be read from far away. What should he do?
questions.a: Use large, bold letters in bright contrasting colours
questions.c: Use light yellow letters on white paper
questions.d: Fill it with many small drawings
questions.exp: Large, bold letters with strong colour contrast can be seen and read from a distance.

questions.q: A border pattern goes: circle, triangle, triangle, circle, triangle, triangle, ... Which shape comes 10th?
questions.exp: The pattern repeats every 3 shapes and circles are at places 1, 4, 7, 10, so the 10th is a circle.

questions.q: In the game of hockey, the ball is hit with a ___.
questions.exp: Hockey players use a curved hockey stick to hit the ball.

questions.q: Padmasana is also known as the ___.
questions.exp: 'Padma' means lotus, so Padmasana is the Lotus Pose.

questions.q: Which game is played by hitting a ball with the hands over a high net?
questions.exp: In volleyball, players hit the ball with their hands over a net.

questions.q: How many players does each team have on the field in a cricket match?
questions.exp: A cricket team has 11 players on the field.

questions.q: Why should we not do hard exercise just after a heavy meal?
questions.a: It makes us grow taller very quickly
questions.b: It can upset the stomach while food digests
questions.c: It makes the food taste bad later
questions.d: It builds muscles faster than usual
questions.exp: After a heavy meal the body is busy digesting; hard exercise then can cause cramps or discomfort.

questions.q: In Anulom-Vilom pranayama, how do we breathe?
questions.a: Hold the breath for as long as possible
questions.b: Breathe in and out only through the mouth
questions.d: In and out through alternate nostrils
questions.exp: Anulom-Vilom is alternate nostril breathing: in through one nostril, out through the other.

questions.q: What is the main benefit of stretching exercises?
questions.exp: Stretching makes muscles and joints flexible and helps prevent injuries.

questions.q: In a 100 m race, what is a 'false start'?
questions.exp: A false start is when a runner starts moving before the starting signal is given.

questions.q: Neha runs round a 400 m track 3 times on Monday and 5 times on Tuesday. How far does she run in total?
Ravi has a long football match on a very hot afternoon. Which is the best plan for him?
questions.a: Drink nothing at all until the match ends
questions.b: Wear thick woollen clothes to sweat more
questions.c: Play for hours without a break
questions.d: Sip water often and rest in shade
questions.exp: Sipping water and resting in shade replace lost sweat and prevent overheating.

questions.q: Which word is spelt correctly?
questions.exp: 'Necessary' has one 'c' and a double 's'.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'expand'.
questions.exp: To expand is to become larger; to contract is to become smaller. The other options are similar in meaning to 'expand'.

questions.q: What is the plural of 'leaf'?
questions.exp: Many nouns ending in -f change the f to v and add -es: leaf becomes leaves.

questions.q: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
questions.exp: A sentence begins with a capital letter, and a question ends with a question mark.

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Yesterday, Meera ______ a letter to her grandmother.
questions.exp: 'Yesterday' shows a completed past action, so the simple past 'wrote' is correct.

questions.q: Which word is an adverb in this sentence? 'The tortoise walked slowly across the road.'
questions.exp: 'Slowly' tells us how the tortoise walked, so it describes the verb and is an adverb.

questions.q: Riya said, "The spelling test was a piece of cake." What does 'a piece of cake' mean here?
questions.exp: The idiom 'a piece of cake' means something that is very easy to do.

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Each of the students ______ a notebook.
questions.exp: 'Each' is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'has'.

questions.q: Mother said, "I am baking a cake." Choose the correct reported (indirect) form.
questions.a: Mother said that she was baking a cake.
questions.b: Mother said that I am baking a cake.
questions.c: Mother said that she is baked a cake.
questions.d: Mother told that I was baking a cake.
questions.exp: In reported speech 'I' becomes 'she' and the present continuous 'am baking' changes to the past continuous 'was baking'.

questions.q: Read: "Arjun had forgotten his umbrella. When the dark clouds burst, he ran under a shop's roof, his clothes dripping, but he was laughing." What can we infer from these lines?
questions.a: Arjun was upset about getting wet
questions.exp: 'Dark clouds burst' and 'clothes dripping' show that heavy rain began; his laughing shows he was not upset.

questions.q: शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
questions.exp: सही शब्द 'आशीर्वाद' है, जिसमें 'शी' पर बड़ी ई और 'र्वा' में आधा र है।

questions.q: 'उदय' का विलोम शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: उदय का अर्थ है निकलना या उगना, और इसका उल्टा 'अस्त' यानी डूबना है।

questions.q: 'जल' का पर्यायवाची शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'नीर' का अर्थ पानी है; अनल आग, समीर हवा और धरा धरती के पर्यायवाची हैं।

questions.q: इनमें से कौन-सा शब्द स्त्रीलिंग है?
questions.exp: हम 'नदी बहती है' कहते हैं, इसलिए नदी स्त्रीलिंग है; बाकी तीनों शब्द पुल्लिंग हैं।

questions.q: 'बच्चे मैदान में दौड़ रहे हैं।' इस वाक्य में क्रिया पद कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'दौड़ रहे हैं' से काम का होना पता चलता है, इसलिए यह क्रिया है।

questions.q: 'आसमान सिर पर उठाना' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
questions.exp: इस मुहावरे का अर्थ है बहुत शोर या हंगामा करना, जैसे 'बच्चों ने कक्षा में आसमान सिर पर उठा लिया।'

questions.q: 'अनुशासन' शब्द में कौन-सा उपसर्ग है?
questions.exp: अनुशासन = अनु (उपसर्ग) + शासन (मूल शब्द)।

questions.q: 'बच्चा' शब्द से बनने वाली भाववाचक संज्ञा कौन-सी है?
questions.exp: 'बचपन' बच्चा होने की अवस्था (भाव) बताता है; 'बचाव' तो 'बचना' क्रिया से बनता है।

questions.q: इनमें से शुद्ध वाक्य कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'जाना है' जैसी आवश्यकता बताने वाली रचना के साथ 'मुझे' आता है; 'मैंने' और 'मेरे को' का प्रयोग यहाँ अशुद्ध है।

questions.q: पढ़िए: "रीना ने परीक्षा की तैयारी देर से शुरू की, फिर भी वह रोज़ समय बाँधकर ध्यान से पढ़ती रही और अच्छे अंकों से उत्तीर्ण हुई।" इन पंक्तियों से क्या सीख मिलती है?
questions.b: देर से पढ़ना सबसे अच्छा है
questions.c: अंक केवल भाग्य से मिलते हैं
questions.d: नियमित और एकाग्र परिश्रम सफलता दिलाता है
questions.exp: रीना रोज़ समय बाँधकर ध्यान से पढ़ी, इसलिए सफल हुई; अंश नियमित मेहनत का महत्त्व बताता है।

questions.q: The triangular numbers are 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, ... What is the next triangular number?
questions.exp: The differences go 2, 3, 4, 5, so the next difference is 6: 15 + 6 = 21.

questions.q: How many straight lines can be drawn through two given points?
questions.exp: Through any two distinct points, exactly one straight line passes.

questions.q: Which of these numbers is a palindrome (reads the same from left to right and right to left)?
questions.exp: 12321 read backwards is still 12321.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
questions.exp: Each line from a vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side is a line of symmetry, giving 3 lines.

questions.q: A class has 45 students. Two-thirds of them come to school by bus. How many students come by bus?
Which pair of numbers is co-prime (has no common factor other than 1)?
questions.exp: 8 = 2×2×2 and 15 = 3×5 share no common factor; the other pairs share 6, 3 and 5 respectively.

questions.q: Find the value of (−7) + (+12) − (−3).
questions.exp: −7 + 12 = 5, and subtracting −3 means adding 3: 5 + 3 = 8.

questions.q: What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at exactly 4 o'clock?
questions.exp: The 12 hour marks divide 360° into 30° each; at 4 o'clock the hands are 4 marks apart: 4 × 30° = 120°.

questions.q: A square and a rectangle each have a perimeter of 36 cm. The rectangle is 12 cm long. How much greater is the area of the square than the area of the rectangle?
questions.exp: Square side = 36 ÷ 4 = 9 cm, area 81 sq cm. Rectangle width = 18 − 12 = 6 cm, area 72 sq cm. Difference = 81 − 72 = 9 sq cm.

questions.q: Rani ate 1/4 of a pizza and her brother ate 3/8 of the same pizza. What fraction of the pizza is left?
Plants with fibrous roots usually have leaves with which type of venation?
questions.exp: Plants like wheat, maize and grass have fibrous roots and leaves with parallel veins.

questions.q: When a few drops of iodine solution are put on a food containing starch, the food turns:
questions.exp: Iodine reacts with starch to give a blue-black colour, which is the test for starch.

questions.q: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.exp: Mercury is the first planet from the Sun, followed by Venus, Earth and Mars.

questions.q: Through which of these materials can we see objects clearly?
questions.exp: Clear glass is transparent and lets light pass through fully; the others are opaque.

questions.q: A pendulum bob moves to and fro about its resting position again and again. What type of motion is this?
questions.exp: Repeated to-and-fro movement about a central position is oscillatory (periodic) motion.

questions.q: The zero mark of Sonu's ruler is broken. He places a pencil so that one end is at the 2.0 cm mark and the other end is at the 13.5 cm mark. What is the length of the pencil?
questions.exp: Length = final reading − starting reading = 13.5 − 2.0 = 11.5 cm.

questions.topic: A journey through states of water
questions.q: Why do wet clothes dry faster on a sunny, windy day?
questions.exp: Higher temperature and moving air both speed up evaporation of water from the clothes.

questions.q: Which method is best to separate insoluble chalk powder from water?
questions.exp: Filter paper lets water pass through but holds back the insoluble chalk particles.

questions.q: Three iron-looking bars X, Y and Z are tested. One end of X repels one end of Y. One end of Z is attracted by both ends of X. Which bars are definitely magnets?
questions.exp: Repulsion happens only between two magnets, so X and Y are magnets. Z's same end is attracted by both poles of X, so Z is only a magnetic material.

questions.q: Seeds were kept in three pots. Pot A: moist soil in a warm room. Pot B: dry soil in a warm room. Pot C: moist soil inside a refrigerator. In which pot(s) will the seeds most likely germinate?
questions.exp: Germination needs water, air and a suitable temperature; B lacks water and C is too cold, so only A has all conditions.

questions.q: The Prime Meridian (0° longitude) passes through which place?
questions.exp: The Prime Meridian passes through Greenwich near London, and longitudes are measured east and west from it.

questions.q: Which is the largest continent in the world?
questions.exp: Asia is the largest continent both by area and by population.

questions.q: Which of these years is the oldest (earliest)?
questions.exp: BCE years count backwards, so 500 BCE is earlier than 200 BCE, and all BCE years come before CE years.

questions.topic: Grassroots democracy: local government in rural areas
questions.q: The elected head of a Gram Panchayat is commonly called the:
questions.exp: The Gram Panchayat is headed by the Sarpanch (also called Pradhan in some states).

questions.q: At which Harappan site was a large dockyard found, showing trade by water?
questions.exp: Lothal in Gujarat had a large brick basin believed to be a dockyard used for boats and trade.

questions.q: The name 'India' comes from the name of which river?
questions.exp: 'Sindhu' became 'Hindu' in Persian and 'Indos' in Greek, from which the name 'India' came.

questions.q: A potter makes pots from clay. In which sector is this activity?
questions.exp: Turning a raw material (clay) into a new product (pots) is manufacturing, which belongs to the secondary sector.

questions.q: A large, raised landform with a mostly flat top, like the Deccan in India, is called a:
questions.exp: A plateau is an elevated area of land with a flat top; the Deccan Plateau is an example.

questions.topic: Locating places on the Earth: longitude and time
questions.q: The Earth turns 360° in 24 hours. When it is 12 noon at Greenwich (0°), what is the local time at a place 45° east of Greenwich?
questions.exp: 360° ÷ 24 = 15° per hour, so 45° ÷ 15° = 3 hours; places to the east are ahead, so 12 noon + 3 hours = 3 p.m.

questions.q: Meena's mother cooks meals for her family every day. She also runs a tiffin service, cooking lunch for office workers who pay her monthly. Which of her activities is an economic activity?
questions.exp: An economic activity earns money or income; the tiffin service is paid, while cooking for the family is unpaid, non-economic work (though still valuable).

questions.q: 'बालिका' शब्दस्य द्वितीयाविभक्तेः एकवचनरूपं किम्?
questions.exp: आकारान्त स्त्रीलिंग 'बालिका' का द्वितीया एकवचन 'बालिकाम्' होता है (जैसे 'लताम्')।

questions.q: '८' इति अङ्कस्य संस्कृतपदं किम्?
questions.exp: ८ को संस्कृत में 'अष्ट' (अष्टौ) कहते हैं; सप्त = ७, नव = ९, षट् = ६।

questions.q: 'सुखम्' इति पदस्य विपरीतार्थकं पदं चिनुत।
questions.exp: 'सुखम्' (सुख) का उल्टा 'दुःखम्' (दुख) है।

questions.q: अधोलिखितेषु नपुंसकलिङ्गपदं किम्?
questions.exp: 'पुस्तकम्' अकारान्त नपुंसकलिंग शब्द है; वृक्षः पुंलिंग तथा लता और नदी स्त्रीलिंग हैं।

questions.q: उचितं क्रियापदं चिनुत: त्वं पत्रं ______ ।
questions.exp: 'त्वम्' मध्यम पुरुष एकवचन है, इसलिए क्रिया 'लिखसि' होगी।

questions.q: उचितं सर्वनामपदं चिनुत: ______ बालकौ क्रीडतः।
questions.exp: 'बालकौ' पुंलिंग द्विवचन है, इसलिए सर्वनाम भी पुंलिंग द्विवचन 'तौ' होगा।

questions.q: 'वयं पठामः' इति वाक्ये 'पठामः' इति पदे कः पुरुषः किं वचनं च?
questions.exp: 'वयम्' (हम सब) उत्तम पुरुष बहुवचन है, अतः 'पठामः' भी उत्तम पुरुष बहुवचन है।

questions.q: 'तुम दोनों पढ़ते हो।' इत्यस्य शुद्धः संस्कृतानुवादः कः?
questions.exp: 'तुम दोनों' = युवाम् (मध्यम पुरुष द्विवचन), इसलिए क्रिया 'पठथः' होगी।

questions.q: अधोलिखितेषु शुद्धं वाक्यं किम्?
questions.exp: 'ते' प्रथम पुरुष बहुवचन है और 'क्रीडन्ति' भी प्रथम पुरुष बहुवचन है; बाकी वाक्यों में कर्ता और क्रिया का पुरुष/वचन मेल नहीं खाता।

questions.q:
पठत: "रमेशः प्रातः उद्यानं गच्छति। सः तत्र मित्रैः सह धावति। ततः सः गृहम् आगच्छति, दुग्धं च पिबति।"
प्रश्नः: रमेशः गृहम् आगत्य किं करोति?
questions.exp: अंश के अनुसार घर आने के बाद रमेश दूध पीता है ('दुग्धं च पिबति'); दौड़ना उद्यान में होता है।

questions.q: Which colour do you get when you add white to red paint?
questions.exp: Adding white to a colour makes a lighter tint; a tint of red is pink.

questions.q: In Indian classical music, the tanpura is mainly played to provide:
questions.b: a steady drone of base notes
questions.exp: The tanpura gives a continuous drone of the base notes (like Sa and Pa) that helps the singer stay in tune.

questions.q: Bharatanatyam is a classical dance form that originated in which state?
questions.exp: Bharatanatyam comes from Tamil Nadu; Kerala has Kathakali, Odisha has Odissi and Manipur has Manipuri.

questions.q: What do we call the person who writes a play?
questions.exp: A playwright writes the script of a play; the director guides how it is performed.

questions.q: Warli paintings of Maharashtra are best known for using:
questions.d: simple shapes like circles, triangles and lines
questions.exp: Warli art shows people and daily life using basic shapes such as circles, triangles and lines, usually in white on a mud-coloured base.

questions.q: How many beats (matras) are there in one cycle of Teentaal?
questions.exp: Teentaal has 16 beats divided into four sections of 4 beats each.

questions.q: Rangoli and kolam designs are traditionally made:
questions.b: on canvas fixed to an easel
questions.c: on the floor, often at the entrance
questions.exp: Rangoli and kolam are drawn on the ground, usually at doorways and courtyards, with rice flour or coloured powders.

questions.topic: Theatre and dance: rasa and expression
questions.q: An actor shows courage and heroism on stage. Which rasa is being expressed?
questions.exp: Veera rasa expresses bravery and heroism; Karuna is sorrow, Hasya is laughter and Shringara is love.

questions.q: Tara is drawing a road with trees going far into the distance. To show depth, how should she draw the trees that are farther away?
questions.a: Smaller and closer to the horizon line
questions.d: At the very bottom of the paper
questions.exp: Objects look smaller as they go farther away and appear closer to the horizon, which creates a sense of depth (perspective).

questions.q: Complementary colours lie opposite each other on the colour wheel. On the red-yellow-blue colour wheel, which colour is complementary to blue?
questions.exp: Orange is made from the other two primaries (red and yellow), so it lies opposite blue on the colour wheel.

questions.q: How many players of the chasing team take the field at a time in Kho-Kho?
questions.exp: The chasing team has 9 players on the field: 8 sitting in the squares and 1 active chaser.

questions.q: How many steps (postures) are there in one round of Surya Namaskar?
questions.exp: One round of Surya Namaskar is a sequence of 12 postures.

questions.q: Which asana, done lying flat on the back with the body relaxed, is usually practised at the end of a yoga session?
questions.exp: Shavasana (corpse pose) is a relaxation pose done lying on the back at the end of practice.

questions.q: How many players of one team are on the field at a time in a football match?
questions.exp: Each football team has 11 players on the field, including the goalkeeper.

questions.q: In Kho-Kho, a runner quickly changes direction to dodge the chaser. Which fitness component is this?
questions.exp: Agility is the ability to change the direction or position of the body quickly and with control.

questions.q: Pranayama is mainly concerned with:
questions.exp: Pranayama means regulating the breath through slow, controlled inhaling and exhaling.

questions.q: What is the safe way to lift a heavy school bag from the floor?
questions.a: Bend at the waist keeping legs straight
questions.b: Bend the knees and keep the back straight
questions.d: Jerk it up quickly with one hand
questions.exp: Bending the knees with a straight back lets the strong leg muscles do the work and protects the back.

questions.q: The traditional Olympic motto 'Citius, Altius, Fortius' means:
questions.exp: The Latin words mean 'Faster, Higher, Stronger'; in 2021 the word 'Communiter' (Together) was added.

questions.q: After resting, Aman counts 18 pulse beats in 15 seconds. What is his heart rate in beats per minute?
questions.exp: 1 minute = 4 × 15 seconds, so heart rate = 18 × 4 = 72 beats per minute.

questions.q: Priya ran for a long time in the hot sun without drinking water. She now feels dizzy and has muscle cramps. What is the most likely cause and the right first step?
questions.a: Hunger; give her chips and let her continue
questions.b: Laziness; ask her to run harder
questions.c: Dehydration; move her to shade and give sips of water or ORS
questions.d: Cold; wrap her in a thick blanket in the sun
questions.exp: Losing water through sweat in heat causes dehydration; resting in shade and slowly drinking water or ORS replaces lost fluids and salts.

questions.q: Which of these wastes is biodegradable?
questions.exp: A banana peel is broken down naturally by microbes; plastic, glass and aluminium are not.

questions.topic: Work with life forms: growing plants
questions.q: Seedlings grown in a nursery bed are later shifted to the main field or pots. This is called:
questions.exp: Moving young seedlings from a nursery to their final place is called transplanting.

questions.topic: Work with machines and materials: measuring tools
questions.q: Which tool is used to measure the length of a wooden plank?
questions.exp: A measuring tape is marked in centimetres and metres for measuring length.

questions.topic: Work with machines and materials: hand tools
questions.q: Which hand tool is used to cut a thin metal wire?
questions.exp: Cutting pliers have sharp jaws that cut through thin wire; a screwdriver turns screws and a spanner turns nuts.

questions.q: Why are earthworms called 'friends of farmers'?
questions.a: They loosen the soil and add nutrients to it
questions.d: They make the soil hard and dry
questions.exp: Earthworms make tunnels that let air and water into the soil, and their castings add nutrients.

questions.topic: Work with machines and materials: simple machines
questions.q: A pair of scissors works as which simple machine?
questions.exp: Each blade of the scissors turns about the central pivot (fulcrum), so scissors work as a pair of levers.

questions.topic: Work in human services: food preservation
questions.q: Mango pickle made at home stays good for many months mainly because:
questions.a: it is kept in the fridge daily
questions.c: salt and oil stop germs from growing
questions.exp: Salt draws out water and oil keeps air away, so germs cannot grow and the pickle does not spoil.

questions.q: Why should we never touch an electric switch with wet hands?
questions.c: Wet hands leave marks on the wall
questions.d: Water conducts electricity and can cause a shock
questions.exp: Impure water is a good conductor, so current can flow through wet hands into the body and cause a shock.

questions.topic: Work with life forms: planning a kitchen garden
questions.q: A school garden bed is 3 m long and 2 m wide. If 4 spinach plants are planted in every square metre, how many plants are needed for the whole bed?
questions.exp: Area = 3 × 2 = 6 square metres; plants = 6 × 4 = 24.

questions.q: The class compost pit has become very wet and smells bad. What is the best way to fix it?
questions.b: Add plastic waste to soak up water
questions.c: Seal it airtight and never open it
questions.d: Mix in dry leaves and turn the pile for air
questions.exp: Bad smell means too much moisture and too little air; dry leaves absorb extra water and turning lets air in so helpful microbes can work.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'enormous'.
questions.exp: 'Enormous' means very large, so 'huge' is its synonym.

questions.q: Which word is spelt correctly?
questions.exp: The correct spelling is 'receive' (the rule 'i before e except after c').

questions.q: Identify the adjective in the sentence: 'Arjun bought a shiny bicycle.'
questions.exp: 'Shiny' describes the noun 'bicycle', so it is an adjective.

questions.q: What is the plural of 'child'?
questions.exp: 'Child' has an irregular plural form, 'children'.

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: 'By the time we reached the station, the train ______.'
questions.exp: The train left before we reached, so the earlier past action takes the past perfect 'had left'.

questions.q: Riya said the maths test was 'a piece of cake'. What did she mean?
questions.c: It was only a small part
questions.exp: The idiom 'a piece of cake' means something that is very easy to do.

questions.q: Which sentence uses the article correctly?
questions.c: He saw an elephant at the zoo.
questions.exp: 'Elephant' begins with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'; the others need 'an honest', 'an apple' and 'a useful'.

questions.q: Choose the best conjunction: 'She was very tired, ______ she finished her homework before sleeping.'
questions.exp: The two ideas contrast (tired, yet finished the work), so 'but' fits.

questions.q: Which of these sentences is in the passive voice?
questions.a: The chef cooked a delicious meal.
questions.b: The chef is cooking a meal.
questions.c: A delicious meal was cooked by the chef.
questions.d: The chef will cook a meal tonight.
questions.exp: In 'A delicious meal was cooked by the chef', the object (meal) becomes the subject and the verb is 'was + past participle', which is passive voice.

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: 'Neither the teacher nor the students ______ happy about the sudden change in the timetable.'
questions.exp: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject; 'students' is plural and the sentence is in the past, so 'were' is correct.

questions.q: 'जल' का पर्यायवाची शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'नीर' का अर्थ पानी है, इसलिए यह 'जल' का पर्यायवाची है।

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
questions.exp: 'विद्या' और 'अर्थी' से बना शुद्ध शब्द 'विद्यार्थी' है, जिसमें 'द्य' और अंत में दीर्घ 'ई' है।

questions.q: 'सुख' का विलोम शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'सुख' का उल्टा अर्थ देने वाला शब्द 'दुःख' है।

questions.q: 'लड़का' शब्द का स्त्रीलिंग रूप क्या है?
questions.exp: 'लड़का' पुल्लिंग है और इसका स्त्रीलिंग 'लड़की' है; 'लड़के' और 'लड़कों' बहुवचन रूप हैं।

questions.q: 'विद्यालय' शब्द का सही संधि-विच्छेद कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: आ + आ = आ (दीर्घ संधि), इसलिए विद्या + आलय = विद्यालय।

questions.q: 'बच्चे मैदान में खेल रहे हैं।' इस वाक्य में क्रिया पद कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'खेल रहे हैं' से काम करने का बोध होता है, इसलिए यह क्रिया है।

questions.q: 'अपने पैरों पर खड़ा होना' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
questions.exp: इस मुहावरे का अर्थ है किसी पर निर्भर न रहकर स्वयं कमाना, अर्थात आत्मनिर्भर होना।

questions.q: 'ईमानदार' शब्द में कौन-सा प्रत्यय लगा है?
questions.exp: मूल शब्द 'ईमान' के बाद 'दार' प्रत्यय जुड़कर 'ईमानदार' बना है।

questions.q: 'रीना ने कहा कि वह कल विद्यालय आएगी।' इस वाक्य में सर्वनाम शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'वह' शब्द 'रीना' संज्ञा के स्थान पर आया है, इसलिए यह सर्वनाम है।

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वाक्य कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: भूतकाल की सकर्मक क्रिया के साथ कर्ता 'मैंने' होता है और क्रिया 'है' के साथ आती है, इसलिए 'मैंने खाना खा लिया है।' शुद्ध है।

questions.q: Which of the following integers is the greatest?
questions.exp: Every negative integer is less than 0, so 0 is the greatest.

questions.q: What is 3.45 + 2.7?
questions.exp: Line up the decimal points: 3.45 + 2.70 = 6.15.

questions.q: Two straight lines intersect. One of the angles formed is 70 degrees. What is the angle vertically opposite to it?
questions.exp: Vertically opposite angles are equal, so the angle is also 70 degrees.

questions.q: What is the value of 48 ÷ 6 × 2?
questions.exp: Division and multiplication are done left to right: 48 ÷ 6 = 8, then 8 × 2 = 16.

questions.q: Find the average (mean) of the numbers 4, 8, 6, 10 and 7.
If 3x + 7 = 25, what is the value of x?
What is 1/3 + 2/5?
questions.exp: Using the common denominator 15: 5/15 + 6/15 = 11/15.

questions.q: Find the value of 3p² − p when p = −2.
The three angles of a triangle are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. What is the measure of its largest angle?
questions.exp: 2 + 3 + 4 = 9 parts = 180 degrees, so 1 part = 20 degrees; largest angle = 4 × 20 = 80 degrees.

questions.q: Two school bells ring every 12 minutes and every 18 minutes respectively. If they ring together at 9:00 a.m., when will they next ring together?
questions.exp: LCM of 12 and 18 is 36, so they ring together again after 36 minutes, at 9:36 a.m.

questions.q: Which of the following is a chemical change?
questions.exp: Burning forms new substances (ash, smoke, gases) that cannot be turned back into paper, so it is a chemical change.

questions.q: What is the SI unit of time?
questions.exp: The second (s) is the SI unit of time.

questions.q: What colour does blue litmus paper turn when dipped in lemon juice (an acid)?
questions.exp: Acids turn blue litmus red.

questions.q: Rusting of iron requires the presence of:
questions.exp: Iron rusts only when both oxygen and water (moisture) are present.

questions.q: In the circuit symbol of an electric cell, the longer line represents the:
questions.exp: In the cell symbol, the longer (thin) line is the positive terminal and the shorter (thick) line is the negative terminal.

questions.q: A simple pendulum completes 20 oscillations in 40 seconds. What is its time period?
questions.exp: Time period = total time ÷ number of oscillations = 40 ÷ 20 = 2 s.

questions.q: Water absorbed by the roots is carried to the leaves through which tissue?
questions.exp: Xylem vessels carry water and minerals from the roots to the leaves; phloem carries food.

questions.q: A solar eclipse takes place when:
questions.a: the Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon
questions.b: the Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth
questions.c: the Sun comes between the Earth and the Moon
questions.d: the Moon moves behind the Earth
questions.exp: When the Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth, its shadow falls on the Earth and blocks sunlight.

questions.q: A bus covers a distance of 150 km in 3 hours at a uniform speed. What is its speed?
questions.exp: Speed = distance ÷ time = 150 km ÷ 3 h = 50 km/h.

questions.topic: Light: reflection in a plane mirror
questions.q: Meena stands 2 m in front of a plane mirror. What is the distance between Meena and her image?
questions.exp: The image is as far behind the mirror as the object is in front (2 m), so the distance between them is 2 + 2 = 4 m.

questions.q: Which instrument is used to measure the amount of rainfall?
questions.exp: A rain gauge collects and measures rainfall, usually in millimetres.

questions.q: What was the capital of the Mauryan Empire?
questions.exp: Pataliputra (near present-day Patna) was the Mauryan capital.

questions.q: Which instrument is used to measure atmospheric (air) pressure?
questions.exp: A barometer measures air pressure; a hygrometer measures humidity and a wind vane shows wind direction.

questions.q: The Thar Desert lies mainly in which Indian state?
questions.exp: Most of the Thar (Great Indian) Desert lies in western Rajasthan.

questions.q: The Arthashastra, a text on statecraft and administration, is traditionally attributed to:
questions.exp: The Arthashastra is attributed to Kautilya, adviser to Chandragupta Maurya.

questions.q: According to early Buddhist and Jain texts, how many mahajanapadas (great states) existed in ancient India?
questions.exp: The texts list sixteen mahajanapadas, such as Magadha, Kosala and Vatsa.

questions.q: On which date did the Constitution of India come into effect?
questions.exp: The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into effect on 26 January 1950, celebrated as Republic Day.

questions.q: A market held on a fixed day each week, where traders set up temporary stalls to sell goods to nearby villagers, is called a:
questions.exp: A weekly haat is held on a fixed day with temporary stalls and serves people of nearby areas.

questions.q: The Iron Pillar at Mehrauli in Delhi has stood for about 1,600 years without rusting. It shows the metallurgical skill of which period?
questions.exp: The Mehrauli Iron Pillar dates to the Gupta period (about the 4th-5th century CE) and reflects advanced iron-working skill.

questions.q: Shimla and Chandigarh are fairly close to each other, yet in summer Shimla is much cooler than Chandigarh. What is the main reason?
questions.a: Shimla is at a much higher altitude
questions.b: Shimla is closer to the sea
questions.d: Shimla gets no sunlight in summer
questions.exp: Temperature falls as altitude increases, so hill stations like Shimla are cooler than plains at a similar latitude.

questions.q: 'फलम्' इति शब्दस्य लिङ्गं किम्?
questions.exp: 'फलम्' अकारान्त नपुंसकलिङ्ग शब्द है (फलम्, फले, फलानि)।

questions.q: 'जलम्' इति पदस्य पर्यायपदं किम्?
questions.exp: 'नीरम्' का अर्थ भी पानी है; अनलः = अग्नि, पवनः = वायु, भूमिः = धरती।

questions.q: 'पठ्' धातोः लृट्लकारे प्रथमपुरुषे एकवचने रूपं किम्?
questions.exp: लृट्लकार (भविष्यत् काल) में 'पठिष्यति' रूप बनता है; पठति लट्, अपठत् लङ् और पठतु लोट् है।

questions.q: 'सः' इति पुंलिङ्गपदस्य स्त्रीलिङ्गरूपं किम्?
questions.exp: तद् शब्द का प्रथमा एकवचन पुंलिङ्ग में 'सः' और स्त्रीलिङ्ग में 'सा' होता है।

questions.q: रिक्तस्थानं पूरयत: 'यूयं विद्यालयं ______।'
questions.exp: 'यूयम्' मध्यमपुरुष बहुवचन है, इसलिए क्रिया 'गच्छथ' होगी।

questions.q: 'अत्र' इति अव्ययपदस्य विपरीतार्थकं पदं किम्?
questions.exp: 'अत्र' = यहाँ, इसका विलोम 'तत्र' = वहाँ है।

questions.q: 'सह' इति पदस्य योगे का विभक्तिः प्रयुज्यते?
questions.exp: 'सह' के योग में तृतीया विभक्ति होती है, जैसे 'रामेण सह'।

questions.q: 'विद्यालयः' इति पदस्य शुद्धः सन्धिविच्छेदः कः?
questions.exp: आ + आ = आ (दीर्घ सन्धि), अतः विद्या + आलयः = विद्यालयः।

questions.q: अधोलिखितेषु शुद्धं वाक्यं किम्?
questions.exp: 'छात्राः' प्रथमपुरुष बहुवचन है और 'पठन्ति' भी प्रथमपुरुष बहुवचन है; शेष वाक्यों में कर्ता-क्रिया का मेल नहीं है।

questions.q: '७:३०' इति समयः संस्कृतभाषायां कथं लिख्यते?
questions.exp: साढ़े (आधा घंटा अधिक) के लिए 'सार्ध' लगता है, अतः ७:३० = सार्धसप्तवादनम्; सपाद = सवा, पादोन = पौने।

questions.q: On a colour wheel, which colour lies directly opposite (is complementary to) red?
questions.exp: Complementary colours sit opposite each other on the colour wheel; red's complement is green.

questions.q: The tabla belongs to which family of musical instruments?
questions.exp: The tabla is played by striking its drumheads with the hands, so it is a percussion instrument.

questions.q: Gond painting, made with dots and fine lines showing animals and trees, is a tribal art mainly from:
questions.exp: Gond art is practised by the Gond community, mainly in Madhya Pradesh.

questions.q: Kathputli, a traditional form of string puppetry, is closely associated with which state?
questions.exp: Kathputli string puppet shows are a well-known folk tradition of Rajasthan.

questions.q: When white is added to a colour to make it lighter, the new colour is called a:
questions.exp: Adding white gives a tint; adding black gives a shade; adding grey gives a tone.

questions.q: Which of these is a wind instrument?
questions.exp: The shehnai is played by blowing air through it; sitar and veena are string instruments and mridangam is a drum.

questions.q: In a landscape drawing, how should objects that are farther away usually be shown?
questions.d: At the very bottom of the page
questions.exp: To show depth, distant objects are drawn smaller and with less detail than nearby ones.

questions.q: In a play, a long speech by one character speaking alone to express thoughts is called a:
questions.exp: A monologue is a speech delivered by a single character.

questions.q: Tara draws a straight railway track. The two rails seem to come closer and meet at a single point on the horizon. What is this point called?
questions.exp: In linear perspective, parallel lines appear to meet at the vanishing point on the horizon line.

questions.q: Teentaal is one of the most common taals in Hindustani music. How many matras (beats) does one cycle of Teentaal have?
questions.exp: Teentaal has 16 matras divided into four vibhags of 4 beats each.

questions.q: How many players of a Kabaddi team are on the court at a time?
questions.exp: A Kabaddi team has 7 players on the court (with substitutes on the bench).

questions.q: In which city were the first modern Olympic Games held in 1896?
questions.exp: The first modern Olympics were held in Athens, Greece, in 1896.

questions.q: What is the normal playing time of a senior football match, excluding extra time?
questions.exp: A football match has two halves of 45 minutes each, i.e. 90 minutes.

questions.q: Which game is played with a shuttlecock?
questions.exp: Badminton is played with rackets and a feathered or plastic shuttlecock.

questions.q: Which test is used to measure flexibility?
questions.exp: The sit and reach test measures flexibility of the lower back and hamstrings.

questions.q: Pranayama mainly involves:
questions.exp: Pranayama is the yogic practice of controlling the breath.

questions.q: Which of these is a correct sitting posture while studying?
questions.b: Back straight with feet flat on the floor
questions.c: Legs tightly crossed on the chair
questions.exp: Keeping the back straight and feet flat reduces strain on the spine and muscles.

questions.q: India's National Sports Day (29 August) celebrates the birthday of Major Dhyan Chand. Which sport did he play?
questions.exp: Major Dhyan Chand was a legendary hockey player who won three Olympic gold medals.

questions.q: After resting, Kabir counts 18 pulse beats in 15 seconds. What is his heart rate per minute?
questions.exp: One minute = 4 × 15 seconds, so heart rate = 18 × 4 = 72 beats per minute.

questions.q: A school team finishes a 4 × 100 m relay in 52 seconds. If all four runners took equal time, how long did each runner take?
questions.exp: Each runner covers one 100 m leg, so time per runner = 52 ÷ 4 = 13 s.

questions.topic: Work with machines and materials: tools
questions.q: Which tool is used to cut wood into pieces?
questions.exp: A saw has a toothed blade used to cut wood.

questions.q: Which animal is reared mainly for wool?
questions.exp: Wool is obtained from the fleece of sheep.

questions.q: Which of the following is biodegradable waste?
questions.exp: Vegetable peels are broken down naturally by microbes; plastic, glass and metal are not.

questions.topic: Work with life forms: plant nursery
questions.q: A place where young plants and saplings are raised for sale or planting is called a:
questions.exp: A plant nursery grows seedlings and saplings until they are ready for planting.

questions.q: The rearing of honeybees for honey and wax is called:
questions.exp: Apiculture is beekeeping; sericulture is silkworm rearing, pisciculture is fish farming and floriculture is flower growing.

questions.q: In a torch, which part converts electrical energy into light?
questions.exp: The bulb or LED glows when current passes through it, turning electrical energy into light.

questions.q: Why should water NOT be used to put out a fire in an electrical appliance?
questions.a: Water conducts electricity and can cause a shock
questions.c: Water is too costly to use
questions.d: Water only works on paper fires
questions.exp: Ordinary water conducts electricity, so pouring it on a live appliance can give a dangerous electric shock.

questions.topic: Work with life forms: modern farming
questions.q: Hydroponics is a method of growing plants:
questions.c: without soil, in a nutrient-rich water solution
questions.exp: In hydroponics, plant roots get nutrients from a water-based solution instead of soil.

questions.q: A tailor needs 2.5 m of cloth to stitch one kurta. Cloth costs ₹120 per metre. What is the cost of cloth for 6 kurtas?

questions.topic: Work with life forms: seed germination
questions.q: In a school nursery, students sowed 50 seeds in trays and 40 of them sprouted. What is the germination percentage?
questions.exp: Germination percentage = (40 ÷ 50) × 100 = 80%.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'ancient'.
questions.exp: 'Ancient' means very old; its opposite is 'modern'.

questions.q: Which word is spelt correctly?
questions.exp: The correct spelling has double 'c' and double 'm': accommodate.

questions.q: Choose the correct article: 'She is ___ honest girl.'
questions.exp: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound (the 'h' is silent), so 'an' is used.

questions.q: What is the correct plural of 'criterion'?
questions.exp: 'Criterion' comes from Greek; its plural is 'criteria'.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: 'By the time we reached the station, the train ___.'
questions.exp: The past perfect 'had left' shows the action finished before another past action (reaching the station).

questions.q: Choose the modal that shows a rule or obligation: 'You ___ wear a helmet while riding a scooter; it is the law.'
questions.exp: 'Must' expresses a strong obligation such as a legal rule.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: 'Neither the teacher nor the students ___ aware of the change in the timetable.'
questions.exp: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject, 'students' (plural), so 'were' is correct.

questions.q: Identify the figure of speech in: 'After the announcement, the hall fell into a deafening silence.'
questions.exp: 'Deafening silence' puts two contradictory ideas together, which is an oxymoron.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice form of: 'The committee will announce the results tomorrow.'
questions.a: The results would be announced by the committee tomorrow.
questions.b: The results are announced by the committee tomorrow.
questions.c: The results will announce by the committee tomorrow.
questions.d: The results will be announced by the committee tomorrow.
questions.exp: Future simple passive = will be + past participle, so 'will be announced' is correct.

questions.q: Which part of the sentence contains an error? 'Each of the players / have been given / a new jersey / for the match.'
questions.exp: The subject 'Each' is singular, so it should be 'has been given', not 'have been given'.

questions.q: 'सूर्य' का पर्यायवाची शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'दिनकर' (दिन करने वाला) सूर्य का पर्यायवाची है; बाकी तीनों चंद्रमा के पर्यायवाची हैं।

questions.q: 'आस्था' का विलोम शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'अन' उपसर्ग लगाकर 'आस्था' का विलोम 'अनास्था' बनता है।

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
questions.exp: शुद्ध रूप 'उज्ज्वल' है, जिसमें 'ज्ज्व' संयुक्ताक्षर आता है।

questions.q: 'बचपन' शब्द किस प्रकार की संज्ञा है?
questions.exp: 'बचपन' एक अवस्था का बोध कराता है, जिसे छुआ नहीं जा सकता, इसलिए यह भाववाचक संज्ञा है।

questions.q: 'परोपकार' (पर + उपकार) में कौन-सी संधि है?
questions.exp: अ + उ = ओ होता है, जो गुण संधि का नियम है।

questions.q: 'राजपुत्र' (राजा का पुत्र) में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.exp: विग्रह में 'का' विभक्ति का लोप होता है और उत्तर पद प्रधान है, इसलिए यह तत्पुरुष समास है।

questions.q: 'ईद का चाँद होना' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
questions.exp: जो व्यक्ति बहुत कम या बहुत दिनों बाद दिखे, उसके लिए 'ईद का चाँद होना' कहा जाता है।

questions.q: 'मीरा ने लाल साड़ी पहनी।' इस वाक्य में विशेषण शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.exp: 'लाल' शब्द संज्ञा 'साड़ी' की विशेषता (रंग) बताता है, इसलिए यह गुणवाचक विशेषण है।

questions.q: 'बच्चों द्वारा राष्ट्रगान गाया गया।' यह वाक्य किस वाच्य में है?
questions.exp: यहाँ कर्ता के साथ 'द्वारा' है और क्रिया कर्म 'राष्ट्रगान' के अनुसार है, इसलिए यह कर्मवाच्य है।

questions.topic: वाक्य के भेद (अर्थ के आधार पर)
questions.q: 'ईश्वर करे, तुम परीक्षा में सफल हो जाओ।' अर्थ के आधार पर यह कौन-सा वाक्य है?
questions.exp: इस वाक्य में वक्ता की शुभकामना या इच्छा प्रकट होती है, इसलिए यह इच्छावाचक वाक्य है।

questions.q: Which of the following numbers is a perfect cube?
questions.exp: 343 = 7 × 7 × 7 = 7³; the others are not cubes of whole numbers.

questions.q: Which is the standard form of 0.000045?
questions.exp: In standard form the number before the power of 10 lies between 1 and 10: 0.000045 = 4.5 × 10^(-5).

questions.q: A quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides is called a:
questions.exp: A trapezium has exactly one pair of parallel sides; a parallelogram and rhombus have two pairs, a kite has none.

questions.q: Just by looking at the units digit, which number can definitely NOT be a perfect square?
questions.exp: No perfect square ends in 2, 3, 7 or 8, so 3137 cannot be a square (1296 = 36², 2025 = 45², 4761 = 69²).

questions.q: A shirt marked at ₹800 is sold at a discount of 15%. What is its selling price?
questions.exp: Discount = 15% of 800 = ₹120, so selling price = 800 − 120 = ₹680.

questions.q: Which property is true for the diagonals of every rhombus?
questions.b: They bisect each other at right angles
questions.c: They are parallel to each other
questions.exp: The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at 90°; they are equal only when the rhombus is a square.

questions.q: Using (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b², find 47 × 53.
₹560 is shared between Asha and Binu in the ratio 3 : 5. How much does each get?
questions.exp: Total parts = 8; one part = 560 ÷ 8 = ₹70. Asha gets 3 × 70 = ₹210, Binu gets 5 × 70 = ₹350.

questions.q: Find the smallest number by which 1620 must be divided so that the quotient is a perfect square, and the square root of that quotient.
questions.exp: 1620 = 2² × 3⁴ × 5; dividing by 5 leaves 324 = 2² × 3⁴, whose square root is 2 × 9 = 18.

questions.q: A 25 m ladder, with its foot on the road, reaches a window 24 m high on one side of a street. Without moving its foot, it is turned to the other side and reaches a window 20 m high. How wide is the street?
questions.exp: Distances of the foot: √(25² − 24²) = 7 m and √(25² − 20²) = 15 m; width = 7 + 15 = 22 m.

questions.q: Which of the following is a compound?
questions.exp: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen chemically combined in a fixed ratio; oxygen and iron are elements and air is a mixture.

questions.q: Which microorganism helps to turn milk into curd?
questions.exp: Lactobacillus bacteria multiply in milk and convert it into curd.

questions.q: Which mirror is used as a rear-view mirror in vehicles?
questions.exp: A convex mirror gives an erect, diminished image and a wider field of view of traffic behind.

questions.q: About how long does the Moon take to go from one new moon to the next new moon?
questions.exp: The cycle of the Moon's phases (a lunar month) takes about 29.5 days.

questions.q: Which of these appliances works mainly on the heating effect of electric current?
questions.exp: An electric iron has a heating element that becomes hot when current flows; bells and cranes use the magnetic effect.

questions.q: Which of the following diseases is caused by a virus?
questions.exp: Chickenpox is caused by a virus; typhoid, cholera and tuberculosis are caused by bacteria.

questions.q: A solution in which no more solute can dissolve at a given temperature is called:
questions.exp: A saturated solution holds the maximum amount of solute possible at that temperature.

questions.q: When incense is lit in one corner, its smell soon spreads across the room. This is mainly due to:
questions.a: Diffusion of its particles among air particles
